scientific_integrity: Proof establishes all real parameter values and dimensions d>=2, with exact finite arithmetic corroboration. Classical Walsh diagonalization and Boolean polynomial minimum-support estimates are credited. Priority remains subject to independent literature review.
scientific_limitations: Binary finite cube, fixed decay parameter between zero and one, real two-parameter quadratic tilt. No nonbinary or higher-degree classification; full boundary principal-rank census beyond first singular cardinality is not asserted.
title: An irredundant Walsh positivity polygon and exact singular-subset thresholds for quadratic Hamming heat kernels
